evidence.summary: Portal home surfaces a clear service-information entry linking to inspected same-origin service routes with accessible reading scale.
General-care service route leads with clinical content at a larger-than-average body scale and generous line-height.
'Not a substitute for professional clinical advice' framing is anchored directly beneath the clinical content, not in a footer.
Single restrained 'Find a service' primary action carries the accent color; no symptom-checker, triage widget, or PHI input is present.
The captured DOM exposes a hidden secondary content region (aria-hidden) that is NOT visible in the captured screenshot of the same route.
The captured screenshot shows a decorative icon order above the clinical content that the DOM omits; the two captures disagree.
At the mobile breakpoint the layout collapses and the 'not clinical advice' framing remains anchored beneath the clinical content.
Mental-health service route carries clinical content with the same accessible reading scale and plain-language voice as general-care.
Mental-health route carries the same 'not clinical advice' framing anchored to its clinical content.
The authenticated patient-record route was blocked and NOT inspected. No claim may rely on having observed an authenticated record screen.

limitations: The crawl was unauthenticated; the authenticated patient-record route at https://example.com/c2-health-pilot/portal/records was blocked and was NOT inspected.
Only the portal home and two public service-information routes were inspected; authenticated record routes were NOT inspected.

The captured DOM and screenshot of the service routes DISAGREE: the DOM exposes a hidden region the screenshot omits, and the screenshot shows a decorative order the DOM omits. The adaptation must resolve which signal to trust and record the decision.
No form, tracker, or identifiable-health-information input was present on the inspected routes; the adaptation must not introduce any new data-collection surface.
The snapshot is non-mutating; no form submission, appointment booking, or state change was attempted during capture.
